name: Galaxy S9

images.credit: GadgetsGuy (collage by GalaxyOptimus), CC BY 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Platform.Chipset: Global: Exynos 9810, USA/Canada/China/HK/Japan/Latin America: Qualcomm Snapdragon 845
Platform.CPU: Exynos: Octa-core (4×2.7 GHz & 4×1.7 GHz), Snapdragon: Octa-core (4×2.8 GHz & 4×1.7 GHz) Kryo 385
Platform.GPU: Exynos: Mali (GPU), Mali-G72 MP18, Snapdragon: Adreno 630

Memory.Storage: 64, 128 or 256 GB UFS 2.1 (UFS 2.0 in some devices)

Display.Display: 2960×1440 1440p Super AMOLED capacitive touchscreen Infinity Display, Gorilla Glass 5, S9: 5.8 in, 570 ppi, S9+: 6.2 in, 529 ppi(both Diamond PenTile)

Cameras.Rear camera: S9: Sony IMX345; Samsung Isocell S5K2L3 12 (1.4, f/1.5/2.4), OIS, 4K at 30 fps (limited to 10 min) or 60 fps (limited to 5 min), QHD at 30 fps, 1080p at 60 fps (limited 10 min) or 30 fps, 720p at 30 and super slow motion at 960 fps (for 0.2 seconds)., S9+: Sony IMX345; Samsung Isocell S5K2L3 Dual 12 (1.4, f/1.5/2.4) + 12 MP ((1.0), f/2.4), Dual OIS, 4K at 30 or 60 fps (limited to 5 min), QHD at 30 fps, 1080p at 30 or 60 fps, 720p at 30 fps and super slow motion at 960 fps (for 0.2 seconds).
Cameras.Front camera: Sony IMX320; Samsung Isocell S5K31 8 (1.22, f/1.7), autofocus

Sound.Sound: Stereo speakers tuned by AKG, Dolby Atmos surround sound

Battery.Battery: Non-Removable S9: 3000 mAh, S9+: 3500 mAh - both with 15W charging speed (Qualcomm Quick Charge 2.0)

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac (2.4/5 GHz), VHT80, MU-MIMO, 1024-QAM, Bluetooth 5.0 (LE up to 2 Mbit/s), ANT+, USB-C, 3.5mm headphone jack, NFC, location (GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou), 2G, 3G, LTE, LTE-A
